item.title: Union Pacific, Wabtec sign $1.2 billion deal for locomotive modernizations
item.description: PITTSBURGH — Union Pacific and Wabtec have signed a $1.2 billion agreement to modernize UP AC4400 locomotives, which Wabtec says is the largest locomotive modernization investment in rail industry history. item.title: Hyundai Rotem to build new light-rail vehicles for Edmonton
item.description: EDMONTON, Alberta — Korean manufacturer Hyundai Rotem has signed a contract to build 32 light rail vehicles for the Edmonton Transit Service, its second order for Edmonton. item.title: California high speed project marks completion of railhead facility
item.description: WASCO, Calif. — In a ceremony on Tuesday, Feb. 3, California Gov. Gavin Newsom marked the completion of the Southern Railhead Facility for the California high-speed rail project.
